- PLAYED rows in log: **98** (all-time resolved W/L: **97**; post_odds_fix PLAYED: **16**, resolved: **16**)
- Results joined from `play_history` + Stats API backfill for unmatched finals.
- Any bucket with **n&lt;20** is flagged **insufficient — do not conclude**.
